results.question:
Provide a comprehensive overview of idealism as a philosophical position.
Cover its central claims, the major varieties and the figures associated with
them, the principal arguments for it, and the main lines of criticism. Aim for
breadth across the whole topic rather than depth on any single point.

Give a comprehensive overview of the cosmological argument for the existence of
God. Cover the major forms the argument takes, its key premises, the principal
figures, and the most important objections. Aim for breadth across the whole
topic.

Provide a comprehensive overview of the problem of evil in philosophy of
religion. Cover the main formulations of the problem, the principal responses
and defenses, and the key figures. Aim for breadth across the whole topic.

Provide a comprehensive overview of Descartes's epistemology. Cover his method,
his foundational certainties, the role of God, and the principal difficulties
that have been raised. Aim for breadth across the whole topic.

Provide a comprehensive overview of John Stuart Mill's moral and political
philosophy. Cover his utilitarianism, his political principles, and his major
works and positions. Aim for breadth across the whole topic.

Provide a comprehensive overview of conservatism as a political philosophy.
Cover its central commitments, its principal theorists, and the way it differs
from rival traditions. Aim for breadth across the whole topic.

Provide a comprehensive overview of game theory as it bears on philosophy.
Cover the core solution concepts, the canonical games, the main distinctions in
how games are modeled, and the principal applications. Aim for breadth across
the whole topic.

Provide a comprehensive overview of the philosophy of the infinite. Cover the
central distinctions, the major historical and mathematical developments, the
key paradoxes, and the principal figures. Aim for breadth across the whole
topic.
